temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose notices Patricia looking more withdrawn than usual during their bank shifts. When he asks if everything is okay, Patricia says it is nothing really, just personal stuff, and thanks him for asking. He offers to listen if she wants to talk, and she says she appreciates it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose did not have a specific belief that Patricia was struggling; he saw her as a vibrant colleague and had no known reason for concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. His suspicion that something is troubling her becomes more concrete: he believes she may be dealing with personal issues, but she is not ready to share details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jose believes Patricia is troubled by something personal and values his offer of support, though she is private about it.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and slightly uncertain about how much to ask.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be available as a listener and support her without pressuring her to disclose.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a lunch break, Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments. In conversation, Patricia confirms she has been overwhelmed with bills and says financial planning or budgeting help could be helpful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia has personal troubles she is private about, but he does not know the specific cause.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He now believes a major source of her stress is financial pressure, and that she is open to discussing budgeting or financial planning with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jose believes Patricia is financially overwhelmed and receptive to his offer of budgeting or financial planning support when she is ready.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Deepened concern and empathy, with a desire to help and some caution about intruding.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer practical financial planning or budgeting support and wait for her readiness.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose raises his worry that bringing up financial planning may have overstepped. Patricia reassures him that he was not prying and that she is grateful for his offer. He tells her he respects her privacy and wants to support her as a friend; she says she appreciates that.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia is financially overwhelmed and open to help, but he is worried that his earlier financial-planning offer may have felt intrusive or crossed a boundary.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Patricia's reassurance changes his belief: he now believes his offer was welcome, not prying, and that Patricia appreciates his supportive friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jose believes he has not overstepped and that Patricia values his support, while he remains committed to respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially anxious or uncertain, then relieved and reassured.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue offering support as a friend while respecting her privacy and not prying.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose checks in casually about how things are going and weekend plans. Patricia says everything is all good and she is planning a quiet weekend at home. Jose offers to be available if she needs anything or wants to chat; Patricia thanks him and says she will keep it in mind.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After their last conversation, Jose senses that Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately; he also believes she is under financial stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No significant change; her brief, normalizing response reinforces his belief that she appreciates support but wants privacy and is not asking for deeper help right now.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jose believes Patricia wants to handle her issues privately while knowing he is available; he should remain supportive without pushing.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful, warm, mildly concerned, and accepting of her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To stay available and check in casually without pressing for details.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose continues checking in supportively at work. Patricia says she is pretty busy but handling it, thanks him for checking in, and says it is really great to have his support. Jose replies that he is there anytime and that everyone helps each other out.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia appreciates his support but prefers privacy and is handling her issues on her own terms.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No significant change; Patricia's response confirms that she is coping, values his support, and does not need active intervention right now.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jose believes Patricia is busy but managing, appreciates his supportive presence, and knows he is available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Supportive, friendly, and reassured that she feels supported.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue regular, low-pressure check-ins and offer help when needed while respecting her independence.
